card.name: Wording about diluting or mixing in containers
card.fires_on: Small words like "other", "a" or "non" right after "to", "in", "as" or "or" in preparation and mixing instructions, such as what fluid or container to use. Also partway through a few names such as sodium or potassium.

modes.label: Linking word in dilution or mixing instructions
modes.description: A short word such as "other" or "a" before the fluid, container or device used for diluting or mixing.
modes.example: DO NOT ADD LEVOTHYROXINE SODIUM FOR INJECTION TO<< OTHER>> INTRAVENOUS FLUIDS

modes.label: End of sodium or potassium in caps
modes.description: The ending "UM" in SODIUM or POTASSIUM in capitalized injection warnings.
modes.example: CONCENTRATED, POTENT DRUG WHICH MUST BE DILUTED IN DEXTROSE (5%) INJECTION OR SODI<<UM>> CHLORIDE (0.9
